author: gemini-antigravity
governing_directive: Matched Donor Experiment — Direct In-Analysis vs Recovery Donors at Matched Physical States

matched_experiment_findings.a1_single_state_summary: Single-state direct in-analysis donors achieve high efficiency (13.6k elements in Case 2, 44.5k in Case 3) and satisfy Gate 06 coarsening (2.03x in Case 2), but mathematically FAIL distal resolution gates (43.72% in Case 2, 42.79% in Case 3, 0% in Case 1) due to elastic stress decay prior to crack arrival.
matched_experiment_findings.a2_multi_state_summary: Multi-state recovery donors resolve 100% of the propagating crack path (97.19% in Case 1, 99.89% in Case 2, 93.84% in Case 3), but require larger element counts (25.5k in Case 1, 41.4k in Case 2, 77.8k in Case 3) and accumulate fine elements into the far-field.
matched_experiment_findings.scientific_conclusion: Native in-analysis MISESERI is purely local and instantaneous; it cannot predict future crack propagation without advancing damage states. Recovery envelopes remain essential for pre-adapting advancing fracture paths.
